notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Here's a small update for the auto battler and tower defense game modes!

Auto Battler

Added a match won counter for units.
Can now right click units to open unit panel.
Added new quests in the teleport bulletin board. (requires new game to refill)
Added Greedy Cat Effigy, an NPC that can turn monsters into gold depending on matches won and current level of the monster. (requires new game to spawn this NPC)
Can now view innate abilities and immunities when inspecting a unit. (slimes splitting and etc...)
Now indicates whether unit can move when inspecting it.


Tower Defense

Now shows a hoverable popup of the selected unit when choosing a reward.
Moving to outposts now closes the overworld automatically.
Removed mushrooms as a basic reward.
Divine Form now lasts longer.
Divine Form now provides bonus cast range.
Divine Form improved stats.
Now auto picks up loot.
Removed pick up all loot command.


Greedy Cat Effigy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/8eee9b22ce2d2b27781973377e49616fab9c03c6.png

A couple of bug fixes as well, have a good day!

notes.title: December Update
notes.notes:
Hello! I managed to get some stuff done right after the Sporeland update. Here is the summary :

Rusty Shovel
Rusty Shovel can now be crafted and has been reworked. Depending on the area, Rusty Shovel can dig up various random items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/22b40e58e0301e49ee652e07379422bb4e20e5c7.png

New Forageables
Added Truffle, Hard Nut and Ghost Fungus.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/40a3fbc934519414fc1f15254bec83c0f31d5674.png

Basic Recipes
Hidden before, the Crafting Furnace now has a visible list of basic items you can craft. I plan to add more items but for now you have these.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/4da42b03422ed182b3f692bc6aaf606686fca6e5.png

Reworked Affinity System
Overview of the rework. NPCs now :

Avoid entities that they have low affinity with.
Forbid entities they have low affinity with from entering the shop(if NPC is a shopkeeper).
Look for a guard to report to(theft or murder).
Initiate battle with the player if affinity is low.
Keep track of their affinity with units per appearance. So different entities, as long as they look the same will have the same affinity with a NPC.

There are details I did not mention about the affinity system but I'll leave them for you to discover.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/f74b439d83f1881b52d1c69ef0a47cafc83d7e7a.png

Dungeon
Added a new area connected to the Town with a new Rat monster along with it. The Dungeon is where criminals are teleported when caught by guards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/cd673ed7aee13e45ff6a8cf6430cb4158ef8b159.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876654/13ef6259ac17ce3a7260d7c31de9e9c15f240599.png

Thank you for reading. I'll try to push an update by the end of December.
